_note: One entry per day. The key is the date in Africa/Johannesburg, written YYYY-MM-DD. Each entry needs title, instruction (one or two lines), source (the theme or book), and placeholder. Leave placeholder true until the copy is final and in our own words. Keys that are not dates are ignored.

2026-10-06.title: Name the standard
2026-10-06.instruction: Write the one standard you will not drop today, in a single sentence.

2026-10-07.title: First rep
2026-10-07.instruction: Do the hardest useful thing before you open anything else.

2026-10-08.title: One clean page
2026-10-08.instruction: Finish one piece of work completely. Leave nothing half-open.

2026-10-09.title: The quiet hour
2026-10-09.instruction: Protect one hour with no inputs. Use it on the work that compounds.

2026-10-10.title: Say the number
2026-10-10.instruction: Write the single metric that would prove today counted.

2026-10-11.title: Shorter loop
2026-10-11.instruction: Cut one step from something you repeat, and ship the simpler version.

2026-10-12.title: The room
2026-10-12.instruction: Tell one person the standard you are holding. Ask nothing back.

2026-10-13.title: Body first
2026-10-13.instruction: Train, walk, or move before the day makes the decision for you.

2026-10-14.title: Close the loop
2026-10-14.instruction: Finish one conversation or task you have been leaving open.

2026-10-15.title: One decision
2026-10-15.instruction: Make the decision you have been renting time to avoid.

2026-10-16.title: Subtract
2026-10-16.instruction: Remove one commitment that does not serve the standard.

2026-10-17.title: Teach it
2026-10-17.instruction: Explain today’s work in three sentences someone else could use.

2026-10-18.title: Recovery rep
2026-10-18.instruction: Stop on time. Protect sleep like it is part of the work.

2026-10-19.title: Review the week
2026-10-19.instruction: Name what held and what slipped. Set one standard for tomorrow.
